fusions.name: Link to Link
fusions.desc: Sends a mouse racing to the first enemy within 6 tiles to bite it for 4 damage. It then runs on to 2 more enemies within 3.5 tiles, each bite dealing 70% of the original damage, with a 30% chance per bite to leave the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Where It Gives
fusions.desc: A gnawing bite that deals 18 damage and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. It uses up every affliction you have on the target, dealing 50% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Gnaw the Bonds
fusions.desc: Removes up to 2 control conditions from you and your allies. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Slipped Shackle
fusions.desc: Each condition laid on you has a 20% chance to slip off and be sent back to whoever inflicted it.
